en.texte: Enjoy your own company. A man who's fine alone makes better choices.
10 pages a day adds up to about a dozen books a year.
A run clears your head better than any feed. Running coach apps like Atala have the session ready, you just go.
Pay yourself first. Move some money to savings the day you get paid.
Learn a skill that has nothing to do with work. Chess, cooking, a new language.
